performance.read: Each ring is a percent from 0 to 100 — how much of what the athlete tried actually worked.
performance.good: 70%+ offensive means efficient scoring; high defensive means few clean openings given up.
performance.watch: A high percent from very few actions can change fast — read it next to the match volume.

technique.read: Bars count the scores landed: Yuko is 1 point, Waza-ari 2, Ippon 3.
technique.good: More Waza-ari and Ippon means cleaner, higher-value techniques.
technique.watch: Many attempts but few scores points to finishing, not creating chances.

tactical.read: Shows the share of each athlete's actions that were attacks, counters, or defenses.
tactical.good: Leading on attacks usually means the athlete set the pace of the bout.
tactical.watch: A mostly defensive share can mean reacting more than leading.

intensity.read: Taller bars are busier intervals — more attacks, defenses, and counters in that window.
intensity.good: Rising bars late show the athlete pushed hardest when it mattered.
intensity.watch: Quiet stretches are where momentum and points slip away.

discipline.read: Penalty marks show discipline pressure by severity. They are not scoring actions.
discipline.good: Few or no marks usually means cleaner control.
discipline.watch: Repeated or severe penalties can shift advantage to the opponent and affect the match outcome.

tournament_flow.read: Each point is one match — the line tracks attack and defense efficiency across the tournament.
tournament_flow.good: A rising line means the athlete sharpened as the tournament went on.
tournament_flow.watch: Based on completed matches only; big dips flag matches worth reviewing.

tournament_scoring.read: Counts the scores landed by technique across every completed tournament match.
tournament_scoring.good: A tall, varied spread shows a complete scoring toolkit.
tournament_scoring.watch: Leaning on one technique is easier for opponents to read and stop.

tournament_rating.read: Shows overall effectiveness for each match across the tournament.
tournament_rating.good: Steady or rising bars mean reliable, improving performances.
tournament_rating.watch: Trends firm up as more matches finish — one low match can skew a short run.
